uncertain: Which of the two equal-height gabled bodies is MAIN: the right one (larger, 8.80 x 12.00, ridge front-to-back) was taken as MAIN and the left bedroom part as WING; the opposite naming is defensible.
Outline: T lying on its side versus L (front offset only 0.85 m).

Wall ends: the house has 0.5 m wing-wall fins (left gable both ends, right wall at the front). wallLeftPx/wallRightPx are the faces the printed dimensions refer to, not the fin ends (FRONT fin to x=86, REAR fin to x about 1203, RIGHT fin to x=122).

Kinds of the 230 cm high floor-reaching glazings: those with a door swing on the plan (rear) are GLAZED_DOOR, those without (front 90/230, 80/230, kitchen 300/230, right 240/230) are WINDOW; they could be read as glazed doors.
LEFT picture, x 1083-1130, y 340-490: a dark rectangle beside the porch; the plan shows solid wall there, read as shadowed cladding, not an opening.
B1 is one frame per the plan label 352/483 although a transom separates lower and upper glazing; someone could count two openings.
